note: Demo investigations. The web pages, domains (.example), archive dates and the reverse-image index are synthetic; the images are derived from the c2pa-python test photos. Everything ORIGIN computes from them (ingest, fetch, matching, dating, claims, narratives, grades) is produced by the real pipeline. Claims and narratives were extracted by a real model once and are replayed from fixtures/recordings.

pages.title: Floods sweep through Valencia
pages.caption: Floodwater fills a street in Valencia, Spain, on 29 October 2024 after record rainfall.
pages.body: Floodwater fills a street in Valencia, Spain, on 29 October 2024 after record rainfall. Emergency services worked through the night as residents waited for news. Officials said the clean-up would take weeks.

pages.body: This photo shows the flooded street in Valencia on 29 October 2024, residents said. Insurers expect thousands of claims after the storm.
